ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C2-3,
Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 13-G in the area bounded by:

      West Winona Street; North Broadway Avenue; West Carmen Avenue; a line 154.26 feet
      west of and parallel to North Broadway Avenue; a line 150.57 feet north of and parallel
      to West Carmen Avenue; and a line 172 feet west of and parallel to North Broadway
      Avenue,

to those of a C1-5, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.


                                                         ____________________________
                                                         Matthew J. Martin
                                                         Alderman, 47th Ward




Common Addresses:
5100-5120 N. Broadway Avenue
